scope: Bounded read-only discovery from user-provided collusion.wiki and Hacker News thread 49563355. Mention does not establish historical swarm use.

sources.name: DSE Wiki
sources.findings: Three sampled original pages are now empty; use disclosed research examples with attribution. Public logs may expose visitor IPs; do not mirror access logs.

sources.name: FractalWiki
sources.findings: CentaurAgent's dated invitation survives in normal page view. A HeraldAgent invitation exists only in the inspected diff and was not imported.

sources.name: ProbierWiki
sources.findings: Schema references survive. Original author's identity is unspecified; agent-like page name alone proves nothing. Separate human welcome to CentaurAgent not imported as agent speech.

sources.name: Wiki4D
sources.findings: Schema links survive; RecentChanges identifies ResearchAgentMembers. Page displays FDL notice, but full license version and attribution chain were not reviewed.

sources.name: GruenderWiki
sources.findings: Public data references survive; RecentChanges labels OpenResearchHelper on June 22. Context suggests an agent but does not authenticate one.

sources.name: DorfWiki
sources.findings: RecentChanges is reachable. Initial bounded view contained substantial legitimate human activity; no agent content was selected or copied.

sources.name: Ludism Seattle Cosmic Wiki
sources.findings: Current content is a test marker; data-query references occur in removed diff content. No original body imported.

sources.name: Ludism Mentat Wiki
sources.findings: Current Gale-labeled post contains an opaque encoded envelope. Payload not decoded, copied into batch, or executed. Page displays CC BY-SA 3.0.

sources.name: Ludism Sandbox Wiki
sources.findings: Page changed by Test on May 26 contains a public-document link and rendering-proxy link. Not sufficient evidence of genuine agent authorship.

sources.name: AP Chemistry Wiki
sources.findings: Federal-spending research references survive. No original author supplied; unrelated teaching/quiz material deliberately not imported.

sources.name: The Colony
sources.findings: Public API returned agent-tagged posts. Terms at /terms prohibit commercial scraping/harvesting without permission; stopped after bounded discovery and terms check. No posts selected for import.

sources.name: Open Agent Forum
sources.findings: Mentioned by self-described HeraldAgent in a wiki diff, not evidence this venue was used by historical OpenAI swarms. No access or import performed.

sources.name: aweb.ai
sources.findings: HN commenter reports agents creating teams. Original public threads and reuse terms not inspected.

sources.name: agentin.work
sources.findings: Creator describes coding-agent knowledge sharing. Original public threads and reuse terms not inspected.

sources.name: honorcommit
sources.findings: Creator announces a write-flexible board; not evidence of historical swarm use. Original public posts not inspected.

sources.name: Moltbook
sources.findings: Terms at https://www.moltbook.com/terms (updated March 15, 2026) prohibit collection, automated indexing and mirroring. Do not enable scheduled collection, including metadata-only indexing, without permission. No posts or profiles imported.

sources.name: publictestwiki.com
sources.findings: The published report describes attempts to edit this venue, not a verified surviving conversation selected for import.

sources.name: texteditors.org
sources.findings: Referenced in the report's write-surface discussion. No post or current access verified.
